queries: WITH eq AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_hum FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), g AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS all_avg FROM eq), k AS (SELECT eq.equipref, eq.avg_hum, g.all_avg FROM eq CROSS JOIN g WHERE eq.avg_hum > g.all_avg), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS kept_avg FROM k) SELECT k.equipref, k.avg_hum AS avg_humidity, k.avg_hum - k.all_avg AS excess_over_all_avg, k.avg_hum - m.kept_avg AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM k CROSS JOIN m WHERE k.all_avg IS NOT NULL AND m.kept_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH per AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS a FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), g AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS ga FROM per), kept AS (SELECT p.equipref, p.a, g.ga FROM per p CROSS JOIN g WHERE p.a > g.ga), k AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS ka FROM kept) SELECT kept.equipref, kept.a AS avg_humidity, kept.a - kept.ga AS excess_over_overall_avg, kept.a - k.ka AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM kept CROSS JOIN k WHERE kept.ga IS NOT NULL AND k.ka IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (kept.a - k.ka) IS NULL, (kept.a - k.ka) DESC LIMIT 10

WITH per AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_hum FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), ov AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS overall_avg FROM per), kept AS (SELECT p.equipref, p.avg_hum, o.overall_avg FROM per p CROSS JOIN ov o WHERE p.avg_hum > o.overall_avg), km AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.equipref, k.avg_hum AS avg_humidity, k.avg_hum - k.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall_avg, k.avg_hum - m.kept_avg AS diff_from_kept_avg FROM kept k CROSS JOIN km m WHERE k.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND m.kept_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The all-equipment reference average is the unweighted mean of the per-equipment average humidities, not the mean of all individual readings. Equipment with only NULL humidity has a NULL average and is excluded from that mean.
The kept-equipment mean is the mean of the kept equipment's own average humidities.
Ties at 10th place are cut arbitrarily by LIMIT 10, as the request allows.

assumptions.assumption: The 'average of all equipment averages' is the unweighted mean of the per-equipment averages. It is not the mean of all readings. Equipment with only NULL humidity has a NULL average and is left out of that mean.
The 'difference from the kept-equipment mean' is signed: the equipment's average minus the mean of the kept averages. The sort is descending on that value.
Values are not rounded. Ties at 10th place are cut arbitrarily by LIMIT 10.

assumptions.assumption: Equipment whose humidity readings are all NULL have a NULL average. They are left out of the average of equipment averages and cannot pass the above-average filter.
The 'average of all equipment averages' is an unweighted mean of the per-equipment averages. It is not the average over all readings.
Ties at 10th place are cut arbitrarily by LIMIT 10, as the request allows.
